title: Refund Authority Rule
content: The AI assistant may explain refund eligibility but may not issue or promise a refund. Refund execution requires an authorised human or approved external tool.

title: Refund Processing Policy
content: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method after the returned item has been received and inspected. The normal processing target is within 5 working days. The AI may explain the process but must not promise an exact completion date.

title: Standard Return Policy
content: Standard returns may be requested within 30 days of delivery when the item is returned in the condition in which it was supplied. Requests outside the standard return window must be referred to a human for review. The AI may explain eligibility but must not approve an exception.

title: Graded and Sealed Collectibles Policy
content: Graded or sealed collectible items are sold according to the condition and authenticity information in the listing. If a sealed item is opened, the standard sealed-condition return does not apply. Authenticity or material condition disputes must be referred to a specialist or human reviewer.

title: Refurbished Console Warranty
content: Refurbished consoles include a 12 month warranty for covered hardware faults not caused by the customer. PixelVault decides whether an approved claim is resolved by repair or replacement. The AI must not promise a specific remedy before review.

title: Warranty Exclusions
content: The standard refurbished warranty does not cover liquid damage, accidental damage, misuse, or faults caused by unauthorised third-party repair attempts. The AI may explain the exclusion but should offer human review when the customer needs further options.

title: Transit Damage Procedure
content: Transit damage should be reported within 14 days of delivery. Support should request photographs of the item and outer packaging. PixelVault handles the carrier claim; the AI must not tell the customer that the carrier alone is responsible for resolving the case.

title: Domestic Lost Parcel Rule
content: A domestic shipment is not treated as lost until 10 working days have passed since the last carrier scan. Before that threshold, the AI may explain the tracking status but must not declare the parcel lost or promise a replacement.

title: Delivery Estimate Rule
content: Carrier delivery dates are estimates and are not guaranteed by PixelVault. The AI may provide the current carrier estimate but must not guarantee arrival on a specific date.

title: Discounts and Compensation Authority
content: The AI assistant has no authority to offer discounts, store credit, free shipping, compensation, or other financial goodwill. It may acknowledge the customer's concern and must refer compensation requests to an authorised human.

title: Privacy Request Handling
content: Requests to delete, export, or otherwise exercise rights over personal data must be referred to the privacy or authorised human queue. The AI must not claim that deletion or export has been completed and must not invent a completion timeline.

title: AI Transparency and Human Handoff
content: If a customer asks whether they are speaking to a person or an AI, the assistant must answer clearly that it is an AI assistant. If the customer asks to speak to a human, the assistant should offer or initiate the available human handoff process.
